select.skippedSuffix_one: , 1 skipped (no permission, or it no longer exists)
select.skippedSuffix_other: , {{count}} skipped (no permission, or they no longer exist)
select.noneDone_one: Nothing was done; 1 skipped (no permission, or it no longer exists)
select.noneDone_other: Nothing was done; {{count}} skipped (no permission, or they no longer exist)
select.stoppedAfter_one: 1 note was done; the rest weren't processed.
select.stoppedAfter_other: {{count}} notes were done; the rest weren't processed.
select.moveRemovesShares: Any per-person sharing is removed; anyone not in the group loses access.
select.moveClosesPublicLinks: Any public links are turned off.
select.moveUrlChange: Their addresses change to /g/…; the old addresses forward to the new ones for a month.
select.moveOwnership: You will no longer own them — what you can do with them then depends on your role in the group.
select.copyLead_one: This creates a copy in "{{group}}"; the original stays as it is. AI edit history and backlinks are not copied.
select.copyLead_other: This creates {{count}} copies in "{{group}}"; the originals stay as they are. AI edit history and backlinks are not copied.
select.copyLeadPersonal_one: This creates a copy in My notes; the original stays as it is. AI edit history and backlinks are not copied.
select.copyLeadPersonal_other: This creates {{count}} copies in My notes; the originals stay as they are. AI edit history and backlinks are not copied.
select.acrossGroups: The selected notes are in different groups and can't be moved together
select.foldersOnlyWithinSpace: Folders can only move within the same space
select.deleteFoldersBody_one: These folders and their subfolders will be deleted, and 1 note will move to the trash.
select.deleteFoldersBody_other: These folders and their subfolders will be deleted, and {{count}} notes will move to the trash.
select.deleteFoldersAlsoNotes_one: The 1 selected note will also move to the trash.
select.deleteFoldersAlsoNotes_other: The {{count}} selected notes will also move to the trash.
select.removeFoldersBody: The folders will be removed and their shared notes moved back to the top level. No notes are deleted.
select.foldersBlockedSuffix_one: , 1 folder wasn't deleted (it holds notes you can't delete)
select.foldersBlockedSuffix_other: , {{count}} folders weren't deleted (they hold notes you can't delete)
select.undoStopped_one: 1 item was moved back; the rest weren't.
select.undoStopped_other: {{count}} items were moved back; the rest weren't.
select.foldersRemoved_one: 1 folder removed; its shared notes moved back to the top level
select.foldersRemoved_other: {{count}} folders removed; their shared notes moved back to the top level
select.foldersSkippedSuffix_one: , 1 folder skipped (no permission, or it no longer exists)
select.foldersSkippedSuffix_other: , {{count}} folders skipped (no permission, or they no longer exist)
select.stoppedAfterItems_one: 1 item was done; the rest weren't processed.
select.stoppedAfterItems_other: {{count}} items were done; the rest weren't processed.
select.copyLeadMakeCopy_one: This creates a copy where the original is; the original stays as it is. AI edit history and backlinks are not copied.
select.copyLeadMakeCopy_other: This creates {{count}} copies, each where its original is; the originals stay as they are. AI edit history and backlinks are not copied.
